LanguageData.DesignatorRepairItemsDesc: Mark damaged weapons, apparel or armor lying on the ground. Colonists haul them to a repair bench and restore them to full hit points, spending repair kits.
LanguageData.MessageGearNotOnGround: Only gear lying on the ground can be marked. Take it off or drop it first.
LanguageData.RepairBench_NoUsableBench: No repair bench with enough repair kits.
LanguageData.AlertRepairBenchPendingDesc: Marked gear cannot be repaired: there is no repair bench with enough repair kits loaded. Build a repair bench or load more repair kits.
